landing.title: BIL Electronic Journal
landing.subtitle: Grades, SOR/SOCH, activity and behavior — in one app.

features.gradesText: The teacher sets the maximum themselves — 10, 20, 30. Percentages and term grades are calculated automatically.
features.activityText: A separate metric of student activity for each subject.
features.behaviorText: A separate category: remarks and praise, kept apart from grades.
features.classesText: Students are organized by class — no searching through a pile.
